_comment: English art briefs per character id from game.json characters[]. 'design_sk' is copied from game.json for traceability; 'description' is what goes into prompts. Ages are locked per sheet.

ADAM.design_sk: Modrá pracovná bunda, horčicové tričko, hnedá brašna, krátke tmavé vlasy; rúško v 2020 vonku pri ľuďoch. Žiadna podoba s postavami Polda.
ADAM.description: Adam, a 35-year-old Slovak man who repairs audio equipment for a living: an ordinary, likeable civilian with a dry sense of humour. Short dark brown hair, clean-shaven with a hint of stubble, friendly slightly tired face, medium build, average height. He wears an open mid-blue cotton work jacket with chest pockets and the sleeves pushed up a little, a plain mustard-yellow T-shirt underneath, dark grey-blue jeans, and sturdy brown leather shoes. A brown leather messenger bag hangs on a strap across his chest and rests on his left hip. No hat, no coat, no tie, no uniform, no badge.

variants.mask2020: Outdoors among people in 2020 he wears a light blue disposable surgical face mask over his nose and mouth.

ELA.design_sk: Zelená vesta, rúško, dva rôzne perá, pevná doska.
ELA.description: Ela, a 40-year-old Slovak woman who coordinates volunteers in 2020: brisk, matter-of-fact and kind. Shoulder-length brown hair tied back in a low ponytail, a plain bright green padded vest without any logo or text over a grey long-sleeved top, dark trousers and comfortable trainers. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth. Two different pens (one red, one black) are clipped to the vest pocket and she holds a sturdy brown clipboard against her side.
ELA.gesture: She lifts the clipboard a little in front of her with one hand and taps it with the red pen held in her other hand, as if pointing at an entry on her list.
ELA.idle_motion: She stands still in place holding her clipboard against her side, relaxed and alive: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight from one foot to the other. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body, does not bow her head and does not look down. The clipboard stays where it is.
ELA.notes: game.json S03 art_brief says Ela sits under the side wall, but the NPC rect/clear zone is standing-sized (150x320); the sheet is standing (ISSUES ART-NPC-01).
ELA.idle_motion_checklist: She stands still in place holding her clipboard, relaxed and alive: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, a small glance down at the clipboard and back up.

DANA.design_sk: Bordová zástera, rúško, okuliare na hlave.
DANA.description: Dana, a 48-year-old Slovak shop assistant in a small village grocery in 2020: calm, precise, years behind the counter. Shoulder-length dark brown hair with a few grey strands, a pair of reading glasses pushed up on top of her head like a hairband, a kind but tired face with a few fine lines. She wears a plain burgundy (deep wine-red) bib apron without any logo or text, with one front pocket, over a cream long-sleeved blouse with the sleeves pushed to the forearms, dark grey trousers and comfortable black shoes. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). Her hands are relaxed, loosely clasped in front of the apron.
DANA.gesture: She raises one hand and touches the reading glasses on top of her head with her fingertips, as if about to pull them down to read a note; her other hand stays relaxed.
DANA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, relaxed and patient: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, her hands loosely clasped in front of her apron.

MIRA20.design_sk: Biele vlasy, okrúhle okuliare, okrový sveter; iba za zatvoreným oknom.
MIRA20.description: Mira, Adam's 80-year-old grandmother, a retired engineer at home in her house in autumn 2020: sharp-eyed, precise, quietly tender, healthy and lively (not ill, not frail). Short white hair set in soft neat waves, round thin metal-framed glasses, an alert, wry, intelligent face with fine wrinkles and a small knowing smile. She wears a warm ochre (golden yellow-brown) knitted wool sweater over a white blouse collar, dark brown trousers and comfortable house shoes. She is indoors at home, so she wears no face mask. With her right hand she holds a plain dark mobile phone (no logo) to her right ear, the phone on the far side of her head so her whole face stays visible; her left arm is relaxed.
MIRA20.gesture: Still holding the phone to her ear with one hand, she raises her free hand to chest height with the index finger lifted, making a precise point.
MIRA20.idle_motion: She stands still in place holding the phone to her ear, listening: calm breathing, a natural blink, a small attentive nod, a tiny shift of weight.
MIRA20.notes: Only ever seen behind a closed big window (S06), talking to Adam by phone. Bust export cut at the window-sill line plus a behind-glass variant.

ROMAN.design_sk: Tmavá mikina, rúško, dodávka s vymyslenou značkou ŠUP.
ROMAN.description: Roman, a 29-year-old Slovak parcel courier in 2020: relaxed, friendly, never cynical. Short dark-blond hair slightly tousled, light stubble, lean build. He wears a plain dark charcoal hooded sweatshirt (hood down) without any logo, print or text, dark navy work trousers with side pockets and grey-and-white trainers. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers his nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). He holds a small plain brown cardboard parcel (no labels, no logo) under his near arm. His van is not part of the sprite.
ROMAN.gesture: He keeps holding the one cardboard parcel exactly as before, in the same hand at the same place by his hip. He raises his other, empty hand (the arm nearest to the viewer, on the left side of the image) to shoulder height in a relaxed, friendly open-palm wave. There is only one parcel in the image.

LENKA.design_sk: Šedá bunda, rúško, vôdzka, pes s jednou čiernou škvrnou.
LENKA.description: Lenka, a 37-year-old Slovak neighbour walking her dog in 2020: economical with words, quietly amused. Chin-length dark auburn bob, a few freckles. She wears a plain mid-grey zipped soft-shell jacket without any logo, dark blue jeans and brown ankle boots. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). In her near hand she holds a tan leather leash that runs down to her dog Bodka, who stands at her feet in front of her, facing the same way: a medium-sized short-haired white mixed-breed dog with exactly one round black spot on its side, black nose, floppy ears, alert and eager, looking ahead as if it would rather run.
LENKA.gesture: She raises her free hand in a small amused open-palm shrug at shoulder height; the leash hand and the dog stay where they are.

JOZEF.description: Jozef, a 73-year-old Slovak pensioner at the village notice board in 2020: warm-hearted and a little ceremonious, upright posture. Neatly combed white-grey hair, bushy grey eyebrows. He wears a long dark brown wool overcoat, buttoned, over a light blue shirt collar, dark grey trousers and polished black shoes. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers his nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). In his near hand he holds a small folding pocket magnifier: a round lens that swivels out of a black case, folded.
JOZEF.gesture: He raises the unfolded pocket magnifier in front of his eye at face height, as if reading small print on a notice board.

BOZO.design_sk: Tmavomodrá uniforma bez detailného historického hodnostného označenia.
BOZO.description: Božidar Fiala, a 45-year-old Slovak railway station attendant at a small village halt in June 1960: thoughtful, unhurried, fond of clear destinations. A calm, attentive, broad face with a neatly trimmed dark moustache, short dark brown hair greying at the temples, sturdy medium build. On his head a dark navy-blue railwayman's peaked cap with a plain black visor and no badge. He wears a plain dark navy-blue single-breasted uniform jacket, buttoned, with plain dark buttons, a white shirt collar with a dark tie, matching dark navy uniform trousers and polished black leather shoes. The uniform has no insignia, no rank marks, no badges, no emblems, no armband and no text. In his near hand he holds a small folded paper timetable; his other arm hangs relaxed.
BOZO.gesture: He keeps the folded timetable in the same hand at the same place. He lifts his other, free hand to chest height and points ahead to the right with the open hand, as if politely showing a traveller the way.
BOZO.idle_motion: He stands completely still, like a guard on duty, gazing calmly at one fixed point far away to the right. He does not move his head at all and does not turn: only his chest rises and falls with slow breathing, he blinks once, and his moustache twitches in a tiny smile. The folded timetable stays in his hand, the cap stays on, his feet do not move.

BERTA.description: Berta Kovárová, a 68-year-old Slovak village woman on the square of Ivanka pri Dunaji in June 1960: direct, curious and good-natured. A round, weathered, friendly face with lively eyes and laugh lines, a few grey curls showing at her forehead. Her head is covered with a dark blue cotton headscarf with a small white flower print, tied under her chin. She wears a long-sleeved dark brown cotton dress with small white dots, the sleeves pushed up to the elbows, reaching to mid-calf, under a faded light blue cotton bib apron, dark stockings and sturdy black leather shoes with low heels. On her near forearm hangs a round wicker basket with a handle, covered with a red-and-white checked cloth. No text or logo anywhere.
BERTA.gesture: She keeps the basket on the same forearm at the same place. With her free hand she points her index finger forward and down, her eyebrows raised in an amused, appraising look, as if commenting on someone's unusual shoes.
BERTA.idle_motion: She stands still in place with the basket on her forearm, curious and alive: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, a small curious tilt of the head as if watching something across the square, then back. She does not walk and the basket stays where it is.

POSTA.description: Alojz Baran, a 54-year-old Slovak village post-office clerk in 1960: formal and tidy, with an occasional soft streak. A long, serious, clean-shaven face with bushy greying eyebrows and a kind look, thinning grey-brown hair neatly combed back with a side parting, slim build, upright posture. He wears a white long-sleeved cotton shirt buttoned to the collar with a narrow dark grey tie, black cotton protective clerk's oversleeves pulled over both forearms from wrist to elbow, a plain dark grey knitted waistcoat, dark grey trousers and black leather shoes. In his near hand he holds a small rubber date stamp with a round wooden handle; the tip of the index finger of that hand is stained dark violet-blue with ink. No badge, no emblem, no text.
POSTA.gesture: He keeps the rubber stamp in the same hand and raises it to chest height, holding it up a little ceremoniously as if about to stamp a document; his other hand stays relaxed.
POSTA.idle_motion: He stands completely still behind his counter like a patient official, gazing calmly at one fixed point straight ahead to the right. He does not move his head at all and does not turn: only his chest rises and falls with slow breathing and he blinks once. The rubber stamp stays in the same hand at the same place in front of his waistcoat, his other arm hangs still, his feet do not move.

LIDA.design_sk: Tmavá sukňa, sveter, náprstok na šnúrke.
LIDA.description: Lída Fialová, a 43-year-old Slovak costume maker of the village amateur theatre in 1960: organised, lively and quick. A warm, lively face with bright attentive eyes and a quick smile, dark brown hair set in a short wavy early-1960s perm. She wears a hand-knitted rust-red (terracotta) wool pullover with three-quarter sleeves over a white blouse collar, a fitted dark navy wool skirt to just below the knee, light stockings and low black shoes. A small silver sewing thimble hangs on a thin black cord around her neck and rests on the front of the pullover. Her hands are loosely clasped at her waist. No text or logo anywhere.
LIDA.gesture: She raises her near hand to chest height and counts on her fingers, three fingers up, with a brisk, organising look; her other hand stays relaxed at her waist.
LIDA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, lively and busy: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, a quick glance to the side as if toward the stage and back, her hands loosely clasped at her waist. She does not walk.

RUDO.description: Rudolf Pavlík, a 34-year-old Slovak amateur actor at a village rehearsal in 1960: grand stage diction, shy off stage. A thin, friendly, slightly anxious clean-shaven face, short dark hair, lanky build. He wears his stage costume: a far too big brown-and-beige checked jacket whose wide shoulders hang over his own and whose sleeves cover half of his hands, a too-big black bowler hat that sits low on his head, a white shirt with a small dark bow tie, baggy brown trousers and worn brown shoes. His arms hang at his sides, the too-long sleeves covering his hands down to the fingertips. No text or logo anywhere.
RUDO.gesture: He flings his near arm out to the side and up in a grand theatrical declaiming gesture, open palm, chin lifted, as if announcing on stage that everything will turn out well; his other hand rests on his chest. The bowler hat stays on his head.
RUDO.idle_motion: He stands still in place, shy and a bit nervous: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny nervous shift of weight from one foot to the other, his fingertips fidget at the ends of the too-long sleeves. The bowler hat stays on; he does not walk.
RUDO.notes: Base = sheet_npc_3q_oversize2 (NB2 fix: arms down, sleeves over the hands) so the costume reads as too big.

SKLAD.design_sk: Modrá montérková blúza, ruky od prachu.
SKLAD.description: Štefan Haluška, a 51-year-old Slovak storekeeper of a village farm workshop in 1960: curt but willing. A broad, weathered face with a bushy greying moustache, short-cropped greying hair under a dark grey cloth flat cap, strong stocky build. He wears a faded greyish-indigo cotton work jacket (a Czechoslovak montérková blúza), buttoned up, with two flapped chest pockets and a short pencil stub in one pocket, matching faded indigo work trousers and dark brown leather work boots. His big hands and the jacket cuffs are dusty: grey-brown dust on the fingers and palms. His arms hang relaxed at his sides. No text, badge or logo anywhere.
SKLAD.gesture: He holds out his near hand, open and palm up, at chest height in front of him, as if curtly asking for the issue slip; his other hand stays relaxed.
SKLAD.idle_motion: He stands still in place, steady and patient: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, he rubs the fingertips of one hand against his thumb as if feeling the dust. Both arms stay hanging at his sides close to his body; he does not reach out. He keeps his head and body turned toward the right in the same three-quarter view for the whole clip: he never turns toward the camera, never faces the viewer and does not bow his head. His feet do not move.

VERA60.design_sk: Červená šatka, kresliaca doska, puzdro na rydlo.
VERA60.description: Vera Nemcová, a 22-year-old Slovak technical draughtswoman in June 1960: calm, practical and no-nonsense. A fresh, focused face with a level gaze, dark blonde hair to the shoulders, partly covered by a bright red cotton headscarf worn over the top of the head and tied at the back of the neck, the knot at the nape (early-1960s style, not tied under the chin). She wears a short-sleeved white cotton blouse with a small round collar, a full navy-blue A-line skirt to mid-calf and flat brown leather shoes. Under her near arm she holds a light plywood drawing board (about 50 x 40 cm) with a sheet of white drawing paper clipped on; in the same hand a slim dark brown leather case for drawing instruments. No text or logo anywhere.
VERA60.seated: She now sits on a simple park bench made of weathered brown wooden slats with a backrest on dark grey cast-iron legs. There is exactly one drawing board in the image: the same board that was under her arm now lies on her lap, resting on her knees and tilted up toward her; she draws on it with a pencil in her near hand while her other hand steadies the board. The slim leather instrument case lies flat on the bench seat beside her. She sits properly on the bench: her hips are on the seat, her back is upright, her thighs are horizontal, her knees are bent at a right angle and both feet stand flat on the ground in front of the bench. The bench stands on the same ground line as her feet, it is seen in the same three-quarter view as she is and it is only about one and a half persons wide; she sits on its right half. Her face, headscarf, hair, blouse, skirt and shoes stay exactly the same. Keep the same scale: her head is the same size as in the first image, so the seated figure is shorter than the standing one.
VERA60.gesture: She lifts the drawing board up from her knees with both hands and turns it toward the viewer to show the drawing on it: a neat technical pencil drawing of a small mechanical part with dimension lines and no readable text. Calm, matter-of-fact look.
VERA60.idle_motion: She sits still on the bench, drawing calmly: the pencil moves in small careful strokes on the board, calm breathing, one natural blink, she glances up briefly and back down at the drawing. She stays seated, the bench stays where it is and nothing else appears.

DOBRO.design_sk: Sako, dobové okuliare, pero v náprsnom vrecku.
DOBRO.description: Teacher Dobrovič, a 39-year-old Slovak schoolteacher in Bratislava-Dúbravka in December 1982, indoors in his classroom: formal at first, then concrete and human; a real person, not a caricature. An intelligent, slightly reserved clean-shaven face, medium-length brown hair combed to the side and covering the tops of the ears (early 1980s), longish sideburns. Large early-1980s eyeglasses with thin gold-coloured metal frames and big squarish lenses. He wears a brown-and-grey herringbone tweed sport jacket with wide lapels, buttoned once, a light beige shirt with a wide collar and a knitted dark brown tie, a ballpoint pen clipped in the jacket's breast pocket, straight brown trousers and brown leather shoes. Under his near arm he holds a plain grey cardboard document folder. No badges, no pins, no emblems, no text.
DOBRO.gesture: He keeps the folder under the same arm. He raises his free hand to chest height, palm open and turned up, in a calm explaining gesture.
DOBRO.idle_motion: He stands still in place, composed and attentive: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, a small thoughtful nod. The folder stays under his arm and the glasses stay on. He keeps his head and body turned toward the right in the same three-quarter view for the whole clip: he never turns toward the camera, never faces the viewer and does not bow his head. His feet do not move.

RUZENA.design_sk: Svetlá zástera a účes v drdole.
RUZENA.description: Ružena Malá, a 49-year-old Slovak shop assistant of a small housing-estate grocery in Bratislava-Dúbravka in December 1982: direct and kind. A friendly, practical face with rosy cheeks and a few fine lines, brown hair with some grey pinned up in a neat bun at the back of her head. She wears a light pale-blue nylon shop smock-apron with short sleeves and two front pockets, buttoned at the front, over a warm hand-knitted oatmeal-beige cardigan whose long sleeves show from under the smock (the shop is cold in December), a dark brown skirt to below the knee, thick brown tights and brown felt-lined winter ankle boots. Her hands rest loosely in front of her. No text, badge or logo anywhere.
RUZENA.gesture: She opens her near hand, palm up, at chest height in a small sweeping gesture toward the space in front of her, as if presenting the goods on her counter, with a direct, friendly look; her other hand stays relaxed.
RUZENA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, calm and friendly: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, she rubs her hands together once in front of her chest against the cold and lets them rest again. She does not walk.

MARTA82.description: Marta Dobiášová, a 56-year-old Slovak head of a civilian maintenance-supply store room in Bratislava-Dúbravka in December 1982, indoors: precise and patient, able to tell a rule from needless hassle. A composed face with fine lines and an attentive, appraising look, short grey-brown permed hair. She wears a long mid-blue cotton storekeeper's work coat buttoned to the knee, with a breast pocket holding a pencil, over a dark wine-red knitted turtleneck sweater whose collar shows at the neck (December), a dark grey skirt below the knee, thick tights and sensible black shoes. In her near hand she holds a hardboard inventory clipboard with a ruled ledger sheet against her side; her other hand holds a pencil. No text, badge or logo anywhere.
MARTA82.gesture: There is exactly one clipboard in the image, and it stays in the same hand as before: the hand on the LEFT side of the image, which now lifts the clipboard up to her chest. The pencil stays in her other hand (on the RIGHT side of the image), which comes up and points the pencil at a line on the clipboard. She looks up over it with a precise, patient expression. Nothing remains at her side.
MARTA82.idle_motion: She stands still in place, precise and patient: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, she glances down at the clipboard and back up. She does not walk.

SIMON.description: Šimon Rybár, a 60-year-old Slovak school gardener outdoors in Bratislava-Dúbravka in early December 1982: calm and concrete. A weathered, kind, ruddy face with deep laugh lines, grey stubble and a short grey moustache, grey hair under a dark brown knitted wool cap. He wears a heavy knee-length dark bottle-green woollen winter work coat, buttoned, with two big flapped pockets, a grey knitted scarf tucked in at the neck, brown leather work gloves on both hands, dark brown corduroy trousers and sturdy dark brown leather work boots. In his near gloved hand he holds a folded yellow wooden carpenter's folding rule. No text, badge or logo anywhere.
SIMON.gesture: He holds the wooden folding rule unfolded into one long straight piece in both gloved hands, horizontally in front of him at waist height, as if measuring the width of a small protective fence.
SIMON.idle_motion: He stands still in place, calm and steady: slow breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, he taps the folded rule lightly against his other gloved palm once. He does not walk.
SIMON.notes: design 'metre dreva' read as a wooden folding rule (drevený skladací meter); see the hand-off notes.

NINA.description: Nina, a 30-year-old Slovak woman, curator of the Atlas memory exhibition in June 2035 and Ela's daughter: matter-of-fact, quick, clear about the limits of her authority. Straight dark brown hair, shoulder-length, worn loose with a side part and tucked behind one ear, a sharp intelligent face with a direct gaze. She wears a lightweight unlined dark bottle-green knee-length coat, open and unbuttoned, over a plain light grey crew-neck top, slim black trousers and simple white leather trainers. A service identification card hangs on a plain dark grey lanyard around her neck: a white card with a small photo square and a simple blue circle emblem, no readable text. Her arms hang relaxed at her sides. Ordinary clothes of the near future (alpine summer 2035), nothing futuristic, no logos, no face mask.
NINA.gesture: With her near hand (the arm nearest to the viewer, on the left side of the image) she lifts the service identification card on its lanyard a little away from her chest and holds it up toward the right, as if showing her authorization; her other arm stays relaxed. There is exactly one card.
NINA.idle_motion: She stands completely still on the same spot, in the same three-quarter pose facing right as in the first frame, for the whole clip: she does not turn around, does not rotate her body, does not turn her head away and does not walk. Only small signs of life: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. Her feet stay planted and the lanyard card stays where it is.
NINA.notes: S42, outside the hotel Grand Jasná at the temporary info stand of the exhibition. Green coat: magenta key everywhere. Video idle on a flat BLUE canvas (npc_prod.py video NINA --image video_in_3q_blue.png --bg blue): on magenta Hailuo turned her a full 360 degrees twice.

TAMARA.design_sk: Zástera s vreckom na meradlo, tetovanie malej ozubenej bodky.
TAMARA.description: Tamara, a 40-year-old Slovak repairwoman who runs the travelling repair workshop 'Second Life' in June 2035: friendly, practical, unhurried. Wavy dark auburn hair pinned up loosely with a plain clip, a few strands loose, a warm open face with laugh lines, no glasses. She wears a sturdy sand-brown waxed-canvas bib work apron without any logo or text, with a narrow chest pocket that holds a slim steel caliper (a measuring tool) and two lower pockets; under it a plain rust-red short-sleeved T-shirt, dark grey work trousers and sturdy brown leather work shoes. A tiny tattoo of a small cogwheel-shaped dot is on her near forearm. Her hands hang relaxed at her sides. She is a craftswoman, not a barista and not hotel staff. Ordinary near-future clothes (2035), nothing futuristic, no face mask.
TAMARA.gesture: She has taken the slim steel caliper out of her apron's chest pocket and holds it up at chest height in her far hand (the arm on the right side of the image), its jaws slightly open, as if about to measure something small, with a friendly look; the chest pocket is now empty. Her near arm (on the left side of the image) hangs relaxed at her side exactly as before. She has exactly two arms and two hands: nothing stays behind at her right hip.
TAMARA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, relaxed and friendly: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body, does not bow her head and does not look down.
TAMARA.notes: S43, temporary repair table of the travelling workshop in the hotel lobby (not hotel staff). Optional table variant (cut at a table top) if the painter puts the table in front of her.

BORIS.design_sk: Biela brada, modrá košeľa, rukávové záložky.
BORIS.description: Boris, a 64-year-old Slovak archivist of the Atlas exhibition in June 2035: calm, dryly witty, meticulous. A full, neatly trimmed white beard, short white hair receding at the temples, bushy white eyebrows, kind attentive eyes. He wears a plain mid-blue cotton button-up shirt with a collar, tucked in, with black elastic sleeve garters (arm bands) on both upper arms above the elbows, dark grey trousers with a brown leather belt and brown leather shoes. In his near hand he holds one small plain white index card at his side. Ordinary clothes, nothing futuristic, no tie, no face mask.
BORIS.gesture: He raises the index finger of his far hand at chest height in front of his chest, as if adding a precise footnote, with a small wry smile; his near hand keeps holding the one index card at his side exactly as before. There is exactly one index card.
BORIS.idle_motion: He stands still in place, calm and attentive: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body, does not bow his head and does not look down. The index card stays in his hand.
BORIS.notes: S44, at the table of the rented hotel salon. 'rukávové záložky' painted as sleeve garters (arm bands). Optional table variant.

SARA.design_sk: Tmavomodré šaty, tablet, papierová kniha návštev.
SARA.description: Sara, a 28-year-old Slovak contact person of the visiting Atlas exhibition at the visitor centre in June 2035: professional, pleasant, organised. Dark blonde hair in a neat low bun, a friendly composed face, small stud earrings. She wears a simple knee-length dark navy-blue dress with short sleeves and a round neckline, no logo, and comfortable dark navy flat shoes. In her far hand she holds a plain dark grey tablet (no logo, screen dark) at waist height; under her near arm she holds a closed hardbound paper visitor book with a dark red cloth cover and no lettering, pressed against her side. Ordinary near-future clothes (2035), nothing futuristic, no face mask.
SARA.gesture: She raises the plain dark grey tablet in her far hand (the arm on the right side of the image) to chest height and tilts its dark screen slightly toward the right, as if showing it to someone; her near hand keeps holding the closed red visitor book against her side exactly as before. She has exactly two arms and two hands, one tablet and one visitor book.
SARA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, attentive and pleasant: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body, does not bow her head and does not look down. The tablet and the book stay where they are.
SARA.notes: S46, at the small service counter of the visitor centre: counter variant (cut at the counter top) is provided; default is the full figure because the room is not painted yet.

ROBOT.design_sk: Kufríkový tvar, dve kolesá, jednoduché svetelné oči; žiadne zbrane.
ROBOT.description: Ocko, a small friendly autonomous delivery robot (model 2033) waiting on a pavement in June 2035. It is shaped like an upright hard-shell suitcase with generously rounded corners, about knee-to-hip height of an adult, standing on two large dark grey rubber wheels, one on each side at the bottom. The shell is painted a warm cream white with a sunflower-yellow band around the top lid. On its front face is a dark smoked-glass panel with two simple round glowing light eyes in soft pale blue, and below them a small curved row of tiny glowing pale blue dots that looks a little like a smile. On top: a closed parcel lid with a recessed handle; a thin flexible antenna rises from the back corner and carries a small bright orange triangular safety pennant. No arms, no weapons, no sharp edges, no text, no letters, no logos, no number plate. Cute and non-threatening, like a helpful household appliance.
ROBOT.gesture: Its top lid is flipped open upward on its back hinge, showing one small plain brown cardboard parcel (no label) inside the compartment, and its two light eyes are curved upward in a happy look. The wheels stay on exactly the same spot.
ROBOT.idle_motion: The little robot stands in place balancing on its two wheels: it rocks very gently forward and back, its antenna pennant sways slightly, and its light eyes blink once. Its wheels stay on the same spot; it does not drive away and does not turn.
ROBOT.notes: S41, waits on the pavement at the Biela Púť lower station. Sprite height is the robot's real size next to the 512 px adults (shell and wheels about 85 cm); talk = the light-dot 'smile' changes, blink = the light eyes dim. Built with: npc_prod.py stills ROBOT --height 344 (shell + wheels 85 cm = 249 px at the 512 px = 175 cm adult scale; the antenna adds the rest); the Pro sheet faced left and was mirrored.

VIKTOR.design_sk: Tmavé nohavice, biela košeľa s vyhrnutými rukávmi, bez futuristickej uniformy.
VIKTOR.description: Viktor, a 50-year-old Slovak founder of the Atlas archive in June 2035: controlled and convinced, grieving underneath; he has not slept. Short dark hair greying at the temples, slightly unkempt, a day of dark stubble, tired eyes with faint shadows under them, a serious composed face, lean build. He wears a plain white cotton dress shirt, collar open with no tie, sleeves rolled up to the elbows, slightly creased, tucked into dark charcoal trousers with a black belt, and black leather shoes; a plain steel wristwatch. His arms hang at his sides. An ordinary man in ordinary clothes: not a villain, not a caricature, no futuristic uniform, no lab coat, no face mask.
VIKTOR.gesture: He raises his near hand (the arm nearest to the viewer, on the left side of the image) to chest height, palm open and turned slightly upward, fingers relaxed, in a controlled explanatory gesture, as if making a reasoned argument; his other arm stays relaxed.
VIKTOR.idle_motion: He stands still in place, tense but controlled: calm slow breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body, does not bow his head and does not look down.
VIKTOR.notes: S49, at the table of the chronochamber in the Atlas pavilion on Chopok. Optional table variant.

IVAN.design_sk: Funkčné horské oblečenie s vlastným neutrálnym označením.
IVAN.description: Ivan, a 44-year-old Slovak cable-car attendant in June 2035: matter-of-fact and friendly, at home in the mountains. Short dark brown hair, a sun-tanned weathered face with a few lines at the eyes, clean-shaven, sturdy build. He wears functional mountain workwear: a dark slate-blue softshell jacket with signal-orange shoulder panels, zipped halfway, with one small round neutral patch on the chest showing only a simple white pictogram of a cable-car cabin (no letters, no logo), a small black two-way radio clipped to the chest, dark grey technical trekking trousers and brown hiking boots. His arms hang relaxed at his sides. Plausible near-future workwear (2035): no resort brand, no logo, no text, no face mask.
IVAN.gesture: He points with his near arm (the arm nearest to the viewer, on the left side of the image) up and to the right, index finger extended toward the next cable car somewhere above the right edge of the image, with a calm friendly expression; his other arm stays relaxed.
IVAN.idle_motion: He stands still in place, relaxed and at ease: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body, does not bow his head and does not look down.
IVAN.notes: S67, at the Priehyba transfer to the Funitel. Neutral own staff marking (cabin pictogram patch), no resort branding.

TURISTA.description: Milos, a 52-year-old Slovak hiker on a day trip in June 2035: easy-going, with a gentle sense of humour. Short salt-and-pepper hair under a beige cotton bucket sun hat, a friendly face with crow's feet, a neatly trimmed grey moustache. He wears an open faded brick-red lightweight hiking jacket over a plain grey T-shirt, khaki hiking trousers and grey-brown hiking boots, and a small dark blue daypack on both shoulders. In his near hand he holds a small black compact camera on a wrist strap at waist height. Ordinary hiking clothes, no brand logos, no text, no face mask.
TURISTA.gesture: He raises the small black compact camera with both hands to his eye and looks through it toward the right, as if photographing the view through a window; the wrist strap stays on his near wrist. There is exactly one camera.
TURISTA.idle_motion: He stands still in place, relaxed and content: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body, does not bow his head and does not look down. The camera stays in his hand.
TURISTA.notes: S68, standing passenger in the Funitel cabin (the rect is standing-sized).

LEA95.description: Lea, a 33-year-old Slovak schoolteacher in Bratislava in June 1995 who records ordinary everyday sounds with the children of an after-school club: warm, natural and unhurried, a good listener. Short dark brown curly hair (a soft natural mid-1990s perm) framing a friendly oval face, a few freckles, light natural make-up. She wears a plain dark green (bottle green) knee-length cotton summer dress with short sleeves, a round neckline and a row of small covered buttons down the front, no print and no logo, a thin brown belt at the waist, bare legs and simple low brown leather shoes in a mid-1990s cut. Her hands are loosely clasped in front of her waist.
LEA95.gesture: She raises the hand nearer to the viewer to shoulder height with the index finger lifted, as if gently asking the children to listen for a moment, a warm attentive look on her face; her other hand stays relaxed at her waist.
LEA95.idle_motion: She stands still in place, relaxed and attentive, as if listening to a recording: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, her hands loosely clasped in front of her. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body and does not look down.
LEA95.notes: S14 (1995 classroom, by the window). Magenta key (dark green dress).

SONA.design_sk: Pruhované tričko, vrkoč, zošit s lepenými rožkami.
SONA.description: Soňa, an 11-year-old Slovak schoolgirl in June 1995, a member of the school's after-school club who keeps the album of the school team: curious, matter-of-fact and serious for her age, but not stiff. She is clearly a real child of eleven: small and slim, a child's round face and child proportions, not a teenager and not a small adult. Light brown hair with a short fringe, plaited into one long braid that hangs forward over her shoulder. She wears a horizontally striped short-sleeved cotton T-shirt with red, white and navy blue stripes (no print, no logo), knee-length light blue denim shorts, white ankle socks and plain white canvas trainers without any logo. With both hands she holds a thick school exercise book used as a photo album in front of her stomach; its cover is plain blue cardboard and its corners are mended with strips of yellowed sticky tape.
SONA.gesture: She opens the album and holds it out in front of her chest with both hands, the open pages turned toward the viewer, as if proudly showing a page of glued-in small photographs (the photos show only tiny blurred groups of children, no text).
SONA.idle_motion: She stands still in place holding her album, alive and patient: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight from one foot to the other. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body, does not bow her head and does not look down. The album stays where it is.
SONA.notes: S17 (1995 school yard). A child: the sheet's figure is 420 px tall at scale 1 (adults 512 px), so she stands about 0.82 of Adam's height.

ZITA.design_sk: Fialový sveter, novinová zástera, ceruzka za uchom.
ZITA.description: Zita, a 46-year-old Slovak newspaper-kiosk vendor on a housing estate in Dúbravka, Bratislava, in June 1995: quick, observant and good-natured, she knows everybody. Dark blonde hair in a practical short layered mid-1990s cut, a lively round face with laugh lines, and a yellow wooden pencil tucked behind her right ear. She wears a light purple (violet) thin knitted sweater with the sleeves pushed up to the elbows; over it a plain grey-beige canvas newspaper vendor's apron with one big front pocket from which a few folded newspapers stick out (the newspapers show only blurred grey columns, no headlines and no readable text); a dark grey knee-length skirt, skin-tone tights and flat black shoes. Her hands rest relaxed in front of the apron.
ZITA.gesture: She takes the pencil from behind her ear and holds it up in the hand nearer to the viewer at shoulder height, pointing it forward as if making a quick, knowing point; her other hand rests on the apron pocket.
ZITA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, relaxed and alert: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, a small knowing smile. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body and does not look down.
ZITA.notes: S18 (1995 housing-estate yard, her newspaper kiosk). Full figure by default (the NPC rect is standing size); window / window_glass bust variants (sill line at 50 % of the figure height) if the painting puts her inside the kiosk.

EMIL.description: Emil, a 61-year-old Slovak street musician who plays the accordion under the shelter of a tram platform in Karlova Ves, Bratislava, in June 1995: soft-spoken, slow and gentle, with a quiet melancholic humour. Thinning grey hair combed back, a full grey moustache, kind, slightly tired eyes. He wears an old, light knee-length coat (a thin, slightly worn grey-brown cotton summer coat), unbuttoned and hanging open, over a pale blue shirt with the top button open, dark grey trousers and worn brown leather shoes. A red-and-black piano accordion with cream piano keys and white bass buttons (no brand name, no lettering) is strapped to his chest; his right hand rests on the piano keys, his left hand at the bass buttons, the bellows closed.
EMIL.gesture: He pulls the accordion's bellows open into a wide fan and plays a chord, both hands on the keys and buttons, his head tilted a little as he listens to the sound with a gentle smile. The accordion stays strapped to his chest.
EMIL.idle_motion: He stands in place with the accordion on his chest and plays very softly: the bellows open and close only a little, his fingers move gently on the keys, he sways very slightly with the music, calm breathing and a natural blink. He keeps facing ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not walk.
EMIL.notes: S19 (1995 Karlova Ves tram platform, under the shelter). The metronome on the small table belongs to the background.

PALI.design_sk: Sivý plášť, farebná súčiastka v každom vrecku.
PALI.description: Pali (Pavol), a 42-year-old Slovak electronics repairman with his own small repair workshop in Karlova Ves, Bratislava, in June 1995: direct, collegial, with dry humour, practical. Short dark brown hair with a little grey at the temples, a few days of dark stubble, a broad friendly face. He wears a knee-length light grey cotton workshop coat (a technician's dust coat), unbuttoned, over a dark blue short-sleeved polo shirt without any logo, black trousers and black shoes. From every pocket of the coat something small and colourful sticks out: from the breast pocket a red and a yellow screwdriver handle, from one side pocket a coil of bright red wire, from the other a bundle of blue and yellow wires and an orange component. Nothing green. His hands hang relaxed at his sides.
PALI.gesture: He holds up a small black rubber drive belt (a thin rubber loop) between the thumb and index finger of the hand nearer to the viewer at eye level and looks at it critically, as if checking its size; his other hand stays relaxed at his side.
PALI.idle_motion: He stands still in place, relaxed and patient: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, hands relaxed. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not look down.

VIERA.design_sk: Tmavé šaty, retiazka na okuliare, rukávy od prachu.
VIERA.description: Viera, a 64-year-old Slovak antiquarian bookseller who owns a small second-hand bookshop in the Old Town of Bratislava in June 1995: precise, well-read and mildly ironic. Silver-grey hair pinned up in a neat bun, a thin clever face with fine wrinkles and a faint ironic smile. She wears a plain dark navy-black long-sleeved dress of mid-calf length with a small white collar; the forearms and cuffs of the sleeves are visibly greyed with old book dust. Reading glasses with thin dark frames hang on a fine gold chain around her neck and rest on her chest. Dark stockings and black low-heeled shoes. Her hands are loosely clasped in front of her.
VIERA.gesture: She lifts the reading glasses on their chain with the hand nearer to the viewer and holds them up in front of her eyes, peering through them with a dry, slightly ironic look; her other hand stays where it was.
VIERA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, composed and watchful: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, her hands loosely clasped in front of her. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body and does not look down.

ARCHIVAR.design_sk: Vesta, biela košeľa, modré chrániče rukávov.
ARCHIVAR.description: Karol, a 53-year-old Slovak clerk who runs a small technical reading room of an archive in the Old Town of Bratislava in June 1995: formal, exact and a little pedantic, but polite. Neatly side-parted dark hair going grey, clean-shaven, a long serious face. He wears a buttoned dark brown wool waistcoat (vest) over a crisp white long-sleeved shirt with a narrow dark brown tie; on both forearms blue cotton sleeve protectors (old-fashioned office oversleeves) reach from the wrists to the elbows. Dark grey trousers and polished black shoes. He stands upright, his hands together in front of him.
ARCHIVAR.gesture: He raises the hand nearer to the viewer to shoulder height with the index finger lifted in a polite but firm 'one moment, please' gesture, eyebrows slightly raised; his other hand stays in front of him.
ARCHIVAR.idle_motion: He stands still in place, upright and orderly: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, his hands together in front of him. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not look down.
ARCHIVAR.notes: S23 (1995 archive reading room). Speaks as KAROL in the dialogue data.

FOTO.description: Alena, a 38-year-old Slovak photographer who runs a small portrait photo studio with a darkroom in the Old Town of Bratislava in June 1995: calm, precise and sure of her craft. Dark brown shoulder-length hair twisted up at the back of her head and held with a plain wooden clothes peg, a few loose strands; a calm, focused face, no glasses. She wears a dark navy blue knee-length work apron without any logo over a plain off-white long-sleeved cotton top with the sleeves pushed up to the forearms, black trousers and flat black shoes. Her hands hang relaxed at her sides.
FOTO.gesture: She holds up a short strip of developed film negative between the fingertips of both hands at eye level, as if against the light, and studies it with a calm, critical eye.
FOTO.idle_motion: She stands still in place, calm and composed: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, hands relaxed. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body and does not look down.
FOTO.notes: S24 (1995 photo studio). Speaks as ALENA in the dialogue data.

TRH.design_sk: Pásikavá košeľa, veľké hodinky, malý stolík.
TRH.description: Fero, a 50-year-old Slovak trader who sells small electronic parts from a small folding table at the open-air market on Miletičova street in Ružinov, Bratislava, in June 1995: earthy and honest, speaks in short dry sentences. Short greying brown hair, a broad weathered face with a summer tan, clean-shaven. He wears a short-sleeved shirt with bold vertical blue and white stripes, tucked into light grey trousers with a brown belt, and brown leather shoes. A big chunky steel wristwatch with a large round dial sits on his left wrist, clearly visible. His hands hang relaxed at his sides. No table, no stall and no goods in the image.
TRH.gesture: He holds up a small black two-pin plug connector between the thumb and index finger of the hand nearer to the viewer at chest height, showing it with a dry, satisfied look; his other arm stays relaxed so the big wristwatch stays visible.
TRH.idle_motion: He stands still in place, relaxed and patient like a man at his market stall: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, hands relaxed. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not look down.
TRH.notes: S25 (1995 market). Speaks as FERO. The small table is part of the background painting; a counter bust variant (cut at 58 % of the figure height from the top) is provided for standing behind it.

MILADA.description: Milada, a 57-year-old Slovak seamstress who runs a small clothes-repair shop in a shopping arcade in Ružinov, Bratislava, in June 1995: quick and practical, full of craft comparisons. Short auburn-red dyed hair in soft curls, a round lively face with fine lines. She wears a light cream short-sleeved blouse with a soft collar and small buttons, a mid-calf dark brown skirt and flat brown shoes; a yellow cloth tape measure hangs around her neck, both ends dangling on her chest. Her hands rest relaxed in front of her.
MILADA.gesture: She takes the tape measure from her neck and stretches a short length of it between her two hands at chest height, as if measuring something in front of her, with a brisk practical look.
MILADA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, relaxed and busy-minded: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, hands relaxed in front of her. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body and does not look down.
MILADA.notes: S26 (1995 clothes-repair shop, at the sewing machine). Standing full figure (the NPC rect is standing size); a counter bust variant (cut at 55 % of the figure height from the top) for standing behind the sewing table.

JURO.design_sk: Čierne tričko s autorským fiktívnym logom kapely, slúchadlá.
JURO.description: Juro, nicknamed 'Kazeta', a 26-year-old Slovak cassette-tape collector and enthusiastic amateur sound engineer in a basement club in Ružinov, Bratislava, in June 1995: eager, warm, explains things in plain words. Shoulder-length dark brown hair tucked behind his ears, light stubble, bright eager eyes. He wears a plain black short-sleeved T-shirt with a simple invented band emblem printed on the chest (a white stylised cassette-reel shape crossed by a red zigzag line, no letters and no words), loose faded blue jeans and black-and-white canvas high-top sneakers without any logo. A pair of big 1990s over-ear headphones with a coiled black cable rests around his neck.
JURO.gesture: He takes the headphones from around his neck with the hand nearer to the viewer and holds them up in front of his chest, offering them as if saying listen to this, with a delighted grin; his other hand stays relaxed. There is only one pair of headphones in the image, they are no longer around his neck, and nothing else is in his hands.
JURO.idle_motion: He stands in place, relaxed, nodding his head very slightly to a rhythm only he hears: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not look down.

JURAJ.design_sk: Džínsová bunda, skicár, farba na palci.
JURAJ.description: Juraj, a 19-year-old Slovak art student who paints a legal community mural in a pedestrian underpass in Petržalka, Bratislava, in June 1995: quiet, curious and easygoing; clearly a young man of nineteen with a youthful face. Messy light brown hair, slim build. He wears an oversized light blue denim jacket with the sleeves rolled up, open over a plain white T-shirt, baggy dark blue jeans and scuffed white trainers without any logo. A smear of white and sky-blue paint marks his right thumb. Under the arm nearer to the viewer he holds a large closed spiral sketchbook with a plain grey cardboard cover.
JURAJ.gesture: He takes the one spiral sketchbook from under his arm and holds it open in front of his chest with both hands, the open pages turned toward the viewer, showing a loose pencil sketch of panel apartment blocks with small lit windows (no text). There is only one sketchbook in the image; nothing is left under his arm.
JURAJ.idle_motion: He stands still in place, relaxed and a little shy: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, the sketchbook under his arm. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not look down.

DEZI.description: Dezider, a 47-year-old Slovak radio amateur and technician who works in a rented garage in Petržalka, Bratislava, in June 1995: lively and technical, he translates jargon into plain words at once. Short dark hair with a receding hairline, a neat dark moustache, large mid-1990s thin metal-framed glasses, an animated face. He wears a short-sleeved beige cotton shirt with two breast pockets, light brown trousers with a belt and brown shoes. He holds a yellow pencil in the hand nearer to the viewer; his other hand hangs relaxed.
DEZI.gesture: He raises the pencil in his hand to shoulder height and points upward with it, explaining something with lively enthusiasm; his other hand stays relaxed.
DEZI.idle_motion: He stands still in place, alert and lively: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, the pencil in his hand. He keeps looking ahead to the right; he does not turn his body and does not look down.

TONO82.design_sk: Dvanásťročný chlapec, tmavá ofina, veľký sveter, školská taška, drevený model lastovičky; žiadny školnícky plášť ani zväzok služobných kľúčov.
TONO82.description: Tóno, a 12-year-old Slovak schoolboy in early December 1982, outdoors by the school's service window: curious and concrete, a thin lanky boy with a long narrow face, a long straight nose, thick straight very dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown eyes, ears that stick out a little and a thick straight fringe of very dark brown hair down to his eyebrows. He wears an oversized hand-knitted wool sweater in dark brick red with a cream zigzag band across the chest (long sleeves rolled at the cuffs), a knitted navy-blue scarf, brown corduroy trousers and dark brown lace-up winter boots. He holds a small hand-carved wooden swallow model (unpainted light wood, pointed wings, forked tail) in both hands. No keys, no work coat, no hat.
TONO82.pose: Pose: he sits on a low wooden three-legged stool (the seat a little below his knee height), in a three-quarter view turned toward the right: body and face turned about 45 degrees toward the right edge of the image, both eyes visible. Knees bent, both boots flat on the ground in front of the stool, forearms resting on his thighs, the wooden swallow model held in both hands in his lap. A brown leatherette 1980s school satchel with two buckles stands upright on the ground beside the stool, on the left of it. Calm, curious expression, mouth closed. The complete boy, the complete stool and the satchel are visible.
TONO82.gesture: He lifts the wooden swallow model up in front of his chest with both hands and turns it a little between his fingers, looking at it proudly.
TONO82.idle_motion: The boy sits still on the low stool, relaxed and alive: calm breathing, a natural blink, he turns the little wooden swallow very slightly in his hands, a small curious tilt of the head. He stays seated; the stool and the satchel do not move.
TONO82.notes: S64: sits outside the open service window on a low stool (the stool and the satchel are part of the sprite); his grandfather OTO82 works inside behind the window.
TONO82.likeness_core: a long, narrow face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose with a small bump on the bridge, thick straight very dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown eyes, ears that stick out a little, a wide mouth with a lopsided dry half-smile, very dark brown (almost black) hair, a tall lanky build with long arms and a slight forward stoop of the shoulders.

TONO.design_sk: Dvadsaťpäťročný muž, tmavé vlasy, hnedý pracovný plášť, zväzok kľúčov, vlastnoručná kovová lastovička.
TONO.description: Tóno (Anton Farkaš), a 25-year-old Slovak young school caretaker in June 1995: dry humour, practical. A tall lanky young man with a long narrow face, a long straight nose with a small bump on the bridge, thick straight very dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown eyes, ears that stick out a little, clean-shaven, very dark brown hair in a mid-1990s curtain haircut with a middle parting. He wears an open knee-length brown cotton caretaker's work coat over a light blue-and-grey checked short-sleeved shirt, dark grey trousers and brown work shoes. A big bunch of keys on a steel ring hangs at his belt, and on the ring hangs a small handmade swallow cut from tin.
TONO.pose: Pose: he sits on a plain wooden school chair with a straight back, in a three-quarter view turned toward the right: body and face turned about 45 degrees toward the right edge of the image, both eyes visible. He sits upright but relaxed, thighs level, knees bent at a right angle, both shoes flat on the floor; his near hand rests on his near thigh holding a ballpoint pen, his far hand rests on his far knee; the bunch of keys hangs at his near hip. Calm, attentive, dry expression, mouth closed. The complete man and the complete chair are visible.
TONO.gesture: He raises his near hand to chest height and turns one small key between his thumb and index finger (a single key, separate from the bunch at his belt), the pen now held in his other hand.
TONO.idle_motion: He sits still on the chair, relaxed and attentive: calm breathing, a natural blink, a small nod, his fingers move slightly on the pen. He stays seated; the chair does not move.
TONO.notes: S13: art_brief 'Tóno sedí pri evidencii návštev'. The chair is part of the sprite; the visitor-log desk belongs to the background, behind / left of him (ISSUES ART-AGE-01).
TONO.likeness_core: a long, narrow face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose with a small bump on the bridge, thick straight very dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown eyes, ears that stick out a little, a wide mouth with a lopsided dry half-smile, very dark brown (almost black) hair, a tall lanky build with long arms and a slight forward stoop of the shoulders.

TONO20.design_sk: Päťdesiatročný muž s mierne prešedivenými spánkami, okuliare, pracovný sveter, kovová lastovička na okne. Opravy vtáčích búdok sú koníček, nie náhrada práce na dôchodku.
TONO20.description: Tóno (Anton Farkaš), a 50-year-old Slovak school caretaker in late October 2020, still working and not retired, calm, dry humour: a tall lanky man, a little heavier at the waist, with a long narrow face, a long straight nose with a small bump on the bridge, thick straight dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown eyes, ears that stick out a little, short neat very dark brown hair with clearly greying temples, a few lines on the forehead and around the eyes and rectangular thin dark-framed glasses. He wears a dark rust-brown knitted quarter-zip work sweater over a checked shirt collar, dark grey work trousers and brown shoes. He is indoors alone behind his service window, so he wears no face mask. With his far hand he holds a plain dark mobile phone (no logo) to his far ear, the phone on the far side of his head so his whole face stays visible; his near hand holds a small single key at waist height.
TONO20.pose: Pose: standing relaxed in a three-quarter view turned toward the right: body and face turned about 45 degrees toward the right edge of the image, both eyes visible, both feet flat on the ground, calm attentive expression, mouth closed, listening on the phone.
TONO20.gesture: Still holding the phone to his ear with his far hand, he raises his near hand to chest height and turns the small key between his thumb and index finger.
TONO20.idle_motion: He stands still holding the phone to his ear, listening: calm breathing, a natural blink, a small attentive nod, a tiny shift of weight. The phone stays at his ear.
TONO20.notes: S56: only ever behind the closed service window, on the phone with Adam. Default variant window_glass (bust cut at the sill line, pivot = sill).
TONO20.likeness_core: a long, narrow face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose with a small bump on the bridge, thick straight very dark eyebrows, deep-set dark brown eyes, ears that stick out a little, a wide mouth with a lopsided dry half-smile, very dark brown (almost black) hair, a tall lanky build with long arms and a slight forward stoop of the shoulders.

JANA82.design_sk: Pruhovaný sveter, pionierska šatka odložená vedľa výkresu, ceruzka.
JANA82.description: Jana, a 12-year-old Slovak schoolgirl at a school technical exhibition in early December 1982, indoors: quietly precise, lights up when she can explain her drawing. A slim girl with a heart-shaped face and a small pointed chin, large wide-set grey-blue eyes, straight light-brown eyebrows, a small slightly upturned nose with light freckles, light ash-brown hair in a ponytail with a short fringe. She wears a hand-knitted sweater with horizontal stripes of navy blue, red and cream, a dark navy skirt, thick dark red woollen tights and white indoor school slippers. She holds a large sheet of drawing paper with a hand-drawn radio circuit diagram (lines and small symbols only, no readable text) against her chest with her far hand, a pencil in her near hand. She wears no neckerchief and no scarf.
JANA82.pose: Pose: standing in a three-quarter view turned toward the right, exactly like the approved character in the reference: body and face turned about 45 degrees toward the right edge of the image, both eyes visible, both feet flat on the ground, a slightly shy posture with the head tilted a little forward, a small shy smile, mouth closed.
JANA82.gesture: She holds the drawing out a little in front of her with her far hand and points at a spot on it with the pencil in her near hand, eager to explain.
JANA82.idle_motion: She stands still holding her drawing against her chest, a little shy: calm breathing, a natural blink, a quick glance down at the drawing and back up, a tiny shift of weight.

ZUZANA.design_sk: (Zatiaľ nie je v game.json.) Sedemročná Zuzana z Ivanky pri Dunaji, jún 1962: krátke svetlohnedé vlasy s pešinkou na boku, okrúhla tvár, vážne láskavé oči; tmavomodré letné šatôčky s bielymi okrúhlymi gombíkmi, biele podkolienky, sandále, kúsok bielej kriedy. V parku skáče škôlku alebo kreslí kriedou.
ZUZANA.description: Zuzana, a 7-year-old Slovak village girl from Ivanka pri Dunaji in June 1962, playing on her own in the manor park: earnest, observant and quietly brave, a small serious face that warms up slowly. She is clearly a real child of seven: small and slight, a soft round child's face with full cheeks and a small rounded chin, a small nose, a small mouth with a slightly full lower lip, gentle, serious, attentive dark eyes under straight light-brown brows; not a toddler, not a teenager and not a small adult. Short light-brown hair cut in a simple short bob that ends just below the ears, with a side parting, the longer side swept across the top of her forehead, the ends slightly wavy. She wears a simple early-1960s Czechoslovak summer dress of dark navy-blue cotton: short sleeves, a small round white collar, a fitted bodice with a single vertical row of four white round buttons down the front, and a full gathered skirt that ends just above the knees. White knee socks and brown leather children's sandals with a buckled strap. With both hands she holds a short stick of white chalk loosely in front of her tummy. No print, no badge, no text anywhere.
ZUZANA.gesture: She points with her near arm (the arm closer to the viewer) stretched out forward toward the right and slightly down, the index finger extended, as if showing someone a spot on the ground over there; her other hand stays in front of her tummy and keeps the one short stick of white chalk. Exactly two arms and two hands. Her face stays serious and attentive, mouth closed.
ZUZANA.idle_motion: The girl stands completely still in place and keeps exactly the same pose, holding the chalk in both hands in front of her tummy: only slow, calm breathing and one natural blink. Her eyes stay on the right edge of the frame and her head stays level.
ZUZANA.crouch: She now crouches down low on the balls of her feet, knees bent and close together, the skirt tucked over her knees, in the same three-quarter view facing right. With her near hand she draws with the short stick of white chalk on the ground just in front of her toes; her other hand rests on her knee. There is exactly one stick of chalk. Her face, hair, dress, collar, buttons, socks and sandals stay exactly the same, and she looks down at the spot where she draws. Keep the same scale: her head is exactly the same size as in the first image, so the crouching figure is much shorter than the standing one. Do not paint the ground, chalk lines, a drawing or a shadow: the background stays flat green.
ZUZANA.hop_motion: The girl plays hopscotch on the spot with small, low, light hops: her feet rise only a little off the ground and her knees bend only a little. First she lifts one foot a little behind her and does three small hops on the other foot, then she lands on both feet slightly apart, then she hops her feet together again and stands still. Her arms stay close to her body, held slightly out to the sides for balance, and the chalk stays in her hand. She stays on the same spot, in the same three-quarter view facing right, and at the end she stands still again in her starting pose.
ZUZANA.draw_motion: The girl stays crouched on the same spot and draws calmly with the chalk on the ground just in front of her toes: the chalk hand makes small careful strokes, calm breathing, one natural blink, her eyes on her drawing. She stays crouched, her feet do not move, and no lines or objects appear.
ZUZANA.notes: S37 (manor park, Ivanka pri Dunaji, June 1962). Likeness from a family photo supplied by the owner (private; not stored in the repository). A child of seven: the standing figure is 350 px at scale 1 (adults 512 px = 1.70-1.75 m, so ~118-120 cm, 0.68 of Adam; SONA at 11 = 420 px). Variants: playing (hopscotch loop as idle), drawing (crouched, drawing with chalk).
ZUZANA.hop_motion_take1: The girl plays hopscotch on the spot without travelling: she bends her knees and hops up on one foot, lands on that foot, hops again, then jumps and lands with both feet apart, then jumps once more and lands with her feet together. Light, springy, cheerful child's hops, the arms swing a little for balance, the chalk stays in her hand. She stays on the same spot, in the same three-quarter view facing right, and at the end she stands still again in her starting pose.

She wears a plain navy-blue short-sleeved cotton blouse with a small round white collar, tucked into a light beige knee-length A-line cotton skirt, and flat brown leather sandals. Her arms hang relaxed; in her near hand, at her side, she holds one short stick of white chalk between her fingers. No jewellery, no rings, no earrings, no watch, no glasses, no bag, no print and no text anywhere.

Exactly two arms and two hands, exactly one stick of chalk in the whole picture. A small warm smile, mouth closed.

Her eyes stay on the right edge of the frame and her head stays level. The chalk stays in her hand.
